import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(27.9, 32.3)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(16.92)
    .workplane(offset=9.0)
    .circle(1.5)
    .loft(combine=True)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 10.375), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0.0))
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(5.64, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(37.1, 0, 0))
            .polyline([[0.0, -12.5], [0.0, 12.5], [46.512, 8.938], [64.6, 0.0], [46.512, -8.938]])
            .close()
            .extrude(7.15)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 10.375), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 180.0))
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(5.64, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(37.1, 0, 0))
            .polyline([[0.0, -12.5], [0.0, 12.5], [46.512, 8.938], [64.6, 0.0], [46.512, -8.938]])
            .close()
            .extrude(7.15)
    )
)
show_object(result)
